lines.lyric: We're now going to progress to some steps which are a bit more difficult
lines.lyric_hangul: We're now going to progress to some steps which are a bit more difficult

lines.lyric_translation: I go back every day / To me of yesterday
To the life of giving up / I let myself go away

lines.lyric_hangul: But 세상에는 있지 변하지 않는 몆 진실
lines.lyric_translation: But in this world, you know / There are truths unchanged
Time rushes ever forward
There’s no ifs, buts, or maybes
Almost forgotten memories return
Touch of the devil, fateful recall
I still wonder, why did they beckon again

lines.lyric: Maeil ask me, guess it, chaejjik, repeat, oh
lines.lyric_hangul: 매일 ask me, guess it, 채찍, repeat, oh
lines.lyric_translation: Every day ask me, guess it, whip it, repeat oh
Nothing that will change, so
I lock it up again, close

lines.lyric: How much love? How much joy?
lines.lyric_hangul: How much love? How much joy?
lines.lyric_translation: ‘How much love? How much joy?’
Soothe myself and stay calm, alone

lines.lyric: Geurae I don’t care, jeonbu nae
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래 I don't care, 전부 내
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah I don’t care, it’s all
Choices by my fate, so we’re here

lines.lyric: Nae apeul bwa, the way it shinin’
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 앞을 봐, the way is shinin'
lines.lyric_translation: Look ahead, the way is shinin’
Keep goin’ now / (Ready set and begin)
That way, way, way
Wherever my way
Only Ego Ego Ego
Just trust myself

lines.lyric: Mundeuk seuchyeoganeun j-hopei anin jeonghoseoge sam
lines.lyric_hangul: 문득 스쳐가는 j-hope이 아닌 정호석의 삶, hmm
lines.lyric_translation: Life not of j-hope but Jeong Ho-Seok flashes by

lines.lyric: Himangiran eopsgo huhoeman gadeukhhaetgetji ’til I die
lines.lyric_hangul: 희망이란 없고 후회만 가득했겠지 'til I die
lines.lyric_translation: It must have been full of regret with no hope till I die

lines.lyric: Chumeun tteun gureumeul jabeul ppun naye kkumeul tashal ppun
lines.lyric_hangul: 춤은 뜬 구름을 잡을 뿐 나의 꿈을 탓할 뿐
lines.lyric_translation: My dancing was chasing ghosts
Blaming my dream, asking why I live and breathe
Oh my God (God, God, God)
Uh time goes by
Seven years of anguish come out finally
Oppressions all resolved

lines.lyric: Gajang mitteon geudeure dapeun nae shimjangeuro
lines.lyric_hangul: 가장 믿던 그들의 답은 내 심장으로
lines.lyric_translation: Into my heart come answers from my most trusted
‘Only one hope, only one soul’
‘Only one smile, only one you’
Definite answer to the truth of the world

lines.lyric_hangul: 변하지 않는 그 어떤 나, right
lines.lyric_translation: Only one and unchanging me / Right

lines.lyric: Ije I don’t care, jeonbu nae
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제 I don't care, 전부 내
lines.lyric_translation: Now I don’t care, it’s all
Choices by my fate, so we’re here

lines.lyric_translation: Way I trust / Way I go

lines.lyric_hangul: 운명이 됐고 중심이 됐어 (Wherever my way)
lines.lyric_translation: Became my fate / Became my core

lines.lyric_hangul: 힘든 대로 또 슬픈 대로 (오직 ego, ego, ego)
lines.lyric_translation: Hard it was / And sad it was

lines.lyric_hangul: 위로가 됐고 날 알게 됐어 (Just trust myself)
lines.lyric_translation: Still reassured and / Made me know myself
